title: BuckyOS System Test
overview.document: Open the sample document and invite collaborators
overview.intro: Run quick system checks for developers. Each test group offers two ways to run its checks.
overview.browser: In the browser, the current SDK calls each service client directly.
overview.server: On the server, POST /sdk/appservice/selftest runs the same cases in the app service.
overview.future: Manual calls for each service will be available below.
auth.needed: Sign in to start an SSO session.
group.manual: Manual calls for this service will be available here.
ndm.title: Import files and folders with NDM
ndm.about: The SDK checks QCIDs, identifies objects, uploads missing content, registers metadata and verifies dependencies. By default it returns an ObjId without writing to disk. Select the same content again to test deduplication.
ndm.help: Extraction uses NFSP. The server checks permissions and conflicts and keeps existing paths. Each root is committed separately. After a partial failure, retry only unconfirmed items. If the response is lost, check the destination before retrying.
ndm.canFolder: Folder selection preserves the root and paths. Browser FileList omits empty folders. Apps that support directory nodes can keep them with SDK importDirectory.
ndm.noFolder: This browser cannot select folders. You can still upload one or more files.
ndm.released: Local task released. Select the files again to continue.
ndm.identify: Object IDs generated. Readiness has not been confirmed.
ndm.ready: The objects and all required dependencies are ready. You can use the ObjIds.
ndm.cancelled: Cancelled. The task is available to retry.
ndm.needTarget: Enter the destination parent folder before extracting.
ndm.failed: Commit failed. Ready objects and completed paths have been kept.
support.title: Support group and customer links
support.intro: Create a support group with two Zone users and this app’s custom panel. Generate a 48-hour link to let a customer join with a restricted account. The link works repeatedly until expiry. Once a password is set, it is required. Cleanup deletes the group. Only the installing account can generate links.
support.enable: Before generating a link, the installing account must enable sign-in for external customers in the app details in App Service. This is off by default and creating a group does not enable it.
support.panelHint: Members can find the support ticket panel in the group details in Message Hub.
support.announce: {{name}}: staff and customers communicate in the {{session}} session.
support.shared: Staff and customers share this session.
support.invited: Invited: {{names}}. Users in the same Zone accept automatically.
support.createFailed: Could not create the support group
support.expires: Until the customer sets a password, this link grants direct access until {{expires}}. It is shown only once. Send it to the customer through your own channel.
support.linkFailed: Could not generate a customer link
support.keep: The customer account and its link record are kept. Links expire automatically. Generating another link for the same external ID reuses the account.
ticket.title: Support ticket
ticket.reopen: Reopen the link from customer support.
ticket.joinHint: Join the ticket to view and reply to messages.
panel.intro: This custom group panel receives the group and session IDs only. The app service summarizes activity without message bodies.
doc.title: Shared document
tests.xllm.description: Run xllm in a bash subprocess using the inherited OOD and gateway environment. Make a real model request and verify the app and instance identity in AICC usage records. Supports OOD app containers and native Desktop Lite apps and consumes a small amount of model quota.
tests.xllm.title: xllm subprocess identity (#640)
tests.runtime.description: Check that the initialized WebSDK reports its runtime, app ID, Zone and service addresses.
tests.runtime.title: SDK runtime
tests.system_config.description: Read boot/config, then write and read a key under the current user and app namespace.
tests.app_settings.description: Read and write user app settings with SystemConfigClient in the browser and getAppSetting / setAppSetting on the server.
tests.task_manager.description: Create a task, update its progress and state, query it, then archive it.
tests.verify_hub.description: Check the current account and inspect the claims in the session token.
tests.verify_hub.title: VerifyHub session
tests.kevent.description: Subscribe to a unique event using createEventReader, publish it and verify that it returns to the page.
tests.service_clients.description: Run read-only checks on Workflow, AICC and Repo. Test the MsgQueue lifecycle with cleanup. Verify that MsgCenter denies an inbox read without the required permission.
tests.service_clients.title: Service clients
tests.sdk_utilities.description: Check the BNS name and DID round trip, and normalization of SN URLs and regions, without side effects.
tests.sdk_utilities.title: BNS and SN utilities
tests.bucket.description: Test the app’s temporary smoke bucket (one-day retention). Write small objects with putBytes and bind NDM uploads at completion. Read objectUrl using cookies alone, delete the key and verify no_such_key. The server tests write, read and delete with the app service session.
tests.bucket.title: App object bucket smoke test
tests.ndm_proxy.description: Verify trusted runtime restrictions in the browser. The app service queries a missing object and checks that the gateway rejects the restricted outboxCount call.
tests.ndm_proxy.title: NDM proxy
